item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: A journey through states of water
item.stem: On a monsoon morning, Meera's teacher asks why the water vapour rising from the warm fields near her village in Kerala later returns as rain. Which sequence correctly shows how water vapour becomes clouds and then rain, hail, or snow?

options.A: Water vapour rises, cools, condenses into tiny droplets forming clouds, and the droplets grow and fall as rain, hail, or snow
options.B: Water vapour rises and collects overhead as invisible vapour, which falls directly as rain without forming droplets
options.C: Water vapour cools because it first condenses into cloud droplets near the ground, and these then rise to form clouds
options.D: Cloud droplets turn dark and immediately fall as rain the moment each tiny droplet forms
